content: === Introduction ===
The rates of adverse effects of aripiprazole are:[1][2][3][4][5]
=== Adults ===
<info> Akathisia — a sense of unease and restlessness that presents itself with anxiety
<info> Somnolence — which is usually mild and transient and less severe than that seen with most antipsychotics.[6]
<info> Extrapyramidal side effects (e.g. dystonia, parkinsonism, tremor, myoclonic jerks, etc.)
<info> Bradycardia (low heart rate)
<info> Neuroleptic malignant syndrome (Combination of fever, muscle stiffness, faster breathing, sweating, reduced consciousness, and sudden change in blood pressure and heart rate)
<info> Suicidal ideation and behavior
<info> Painful and/or sustained erection (Priapism)
<info> Myocardial infarction (heart attack)
<info> Prolonged QT interval (less common than with most other atypical antipsychotic drugs)[6]
<info> Electrolyte abnormalities including hyponatraemia, hypokalaemia, hypocalcaemia, etc.
<info> Urinary retention or incontinence
<info> Xerostomia (when given by injection)
<info> Tardive dyskinesia (As with all antipsychotic medication, patients using aripiprazole may develop the permanent neurological disorder tardive dyskinesia.)[10][11][12]
Sudden unexplained death has been reported. However, the frequency is unknown.[13]
=== Common in children ===
<info> Uncontrolled movement such as restlessness, tremor muscle stiffness[7]
